address: Al Maha Island, Lusail, Doha, Qatar
bio: Part of an ever-growing group, this Persian restaurant is located on the popular Al Maha Island with great views of the city – a seat on the terrace is always a top choice when weather permits. The food is pure Persian; all the favourites are here such as wonderful breads, tasty black chickpea hummus and kebabs cooked over coals. Don’t miss out on other dishes too – some to share – like the Ghormeh Sabzi, a deliciously flavoured stew, and save room for their saffron-flavoured crème caramel. Pro tip: tea reigns over coffee here....
